recentItems.title: ఏపీలో 263కి పెరగనున్న ఎమ్మెల్యే సీట్లు, 38కి ఎంపీ స్థానాలు! | Delimitation Effect on Andhra Pradesh
recentItems.description:
According to the latest proposals, the central government plans a uniform 50% seat expansion across all states regardless of the census, ensuring Southern states do not lose their political representation. Under this new formula, Andhra Pradesh MLA seats are projected to jump from 175 to 263, while AP MP seats will increase from 25 to 38. Consequently, AP’s representation share in the Lok Sabha will rise from 4.60% to 4.65%. Watch this full report to understand the exact numbers, national seat projections, and CM Chandrababu Naidu's crucial appeal to political parties regarding this historic delimitation process in India.
#Delimitation #APPolitics #AndhraPradeshNews #etvdigital

recentItems.description:
Rajamahendravaram hosted a special celebration marking 222 years of the District Court and 131 years of the Bar Association. Supreme Court and High Court judges attended the event and called for efforts to make the judiciary more accessible to the public. Andhra Pradesh Chief Minister N. Chandrababu Naidu announced that steps would be taken to modernise the judicial system and assured that a POCSO court would be established soon in Rajamahendravaram.

recentItems.title: రేపే రెండో దశ పంచాయతీ పోలింగ్‌.. మధ్యాహ్నం 2 గంటల నుంచి ఓట్ల లెక్కింపు
recentItems.description:
All arrangements are in place for the second phase of Gram Panchayat elections in Andhra Pradesh. Polling will be held tomorrow across 3,880 gram panchayats in 27 districts, with more than 10,000 candidates contesting for sarpanch posts. Over 83.5 lakh voters are eligible to cast their votes. Polling will take place from 7 AM to 1 PM, followed by counting from 2 PM. Results will be announced immediately after the counting process is completed.

recentItems.title: జానకమ్మ గోంగూర పచ్చడి తినిపిస్తే.. ఆ కారమే తియ్యగా ఉంటుంది | KS Chithra Speech in Vijayawada
recentItems.description:
Legendary playback singer K.S. Chithra has officially announced her first-ever live musical concert in Vijayawada, scheduled to take place on the 13th of next month at the Indira Gandhi Municipal Stadium. During the announcement, she mesmerized everyone by singing a special rendition of "Antha Ishtamendayya" with customized lyrics dedicated to veteran singer S. Janaki. Opening up about her vocal care and diet, Chithra revealed that she strictly avoids spicy food to protect her voice and usually prefers mild Telugu dishes like curd rice. However, she fondly recalled how even spicy gongura pickle mixed with ghee feels as sweet as nectar whenever Janaki Amma lovingly feeds it to her by hand. 
#KSChithra #SJanaki #Vijayawada #LiveConcert #TollywoodSingers #Etvdigital

recentItems.title: సుప్రీంకోర్టు ఆదేశాలతో తిరుప్పరంకుండ్రం కొండపై ఎట్టకేలకు వెలిగిన దీపం
recentItems.description:
The traditional lamp was finally lit on the ancient stone pillar at Thiruparankundram Hill in Tamil Nadu’s Madurai district, following Supreme Court directions. Priests of the Subramaniya Swamy Temple lit the lamp at 5 PM using 30 kg of ghee, a 50-metre-long wick and 5 kg of camphor. Retired judges Justice S. Vaidyanathan and Justice Parthiban witnessed the ceremony. A large number of devotees and local residents gathered to witness the event.

recentItems.title: 850 సీట్ల పెంపుతో దేశాన్ని గుప్పిట్లో పెట్టుకునే కుట్ర | మోదీ, షా, జ్ఞానేశ్ కుమార్‌పై రాహుల్ ఆరోపణలు
recentItems.description:
Congress leader Rahul Gandhi has accused Prime Minister Narendra Modi, Union Home Minister Amit Shah and Chief Election Commissioner Gyanesh Kumar of conspiring to consolidate control over the country through the proposed Delimitation Bill. He questioned the proposal to increase Lok Sabha seats to 850, calling it a threat to democracy, and alleged that constituencies could be redrawn in favour of the BJP.
